sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our Angebot is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

As to the index change and price history data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. If you want a better price, we really need faster payment terms from your side. We can drop the price to 46.50 EUR for the 300 ppm commitment. So our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
